title: Disk image / MFT and deleted-file recovery
steps: `ewfmount image.E01 /mnt/ewf` (if E01) then `mmls`, `fsstat`, and `fls -r -p` on the partition offset.
Recover inodes with `icat`/`tsk_recover`; parse `$MFT` with `MFTECmd`/`analyzeMFT` and check `$UsnJrnl` for deletions.
Carve unallocated space with `photorec`/`foremost`; inspect slack with `blkls`/`icat`.
Build a timeline (`plaso`/`log2timeline`) only if the flag depends on when a file was deleted.
falsifier: The filesystem is encrypted or the image is incomplete; carving cannot recover plaintext.
